context.directory_count_policy: directories below fixture root; excludes fixture root
context.fixture_policy: filegen --leaf-files --bufsize=min(file_size_bytes,1048576); random bytes without fixed seed; verified counts and digest
context.timing_policy: monotonic launch-to-last-child-exit; excludes verification and cache preparation
context.verification_policy: exact relative directory and regular-file paths, sizes, and SHA256 contents; source tree must match initial scan after all case trials
